subject: Q3 launch — coverage action sweep & snapshot
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q3 launch — coverage action sweep & snapshot

Team —

As we head into the Q3 launch window I need a quick, executable sweep to close the obvious coverage shortfall in our forecast. Finance ran the updated cadence this morning and the headline is: at current commits we land ~2.1x coverage versus our target of 3.5x for campaign-driven bookings. That gap is a hard blocker for our capacity and spend planning.

Please action the following by close of business Friday (EOD 7/30):
- Each AE to update top 10 deals in SFDC with current stage + realistic close date and refreshed ACV (use Commit / Commit-Strong where appropriate).
- Flag deals you are moving to "Commit" with a short justification in the comment (one line).
- If a deal is >30% risk, move to "At Risk" and add next-step (POC, legal hold, procurement)
- Upload your per-AE tab into the attached Q3_coverage_snapshot.xlsx and push to the Drive link below.

I'll pull a cross-AE heatmap on Monday and propose a short mitigation plan (discount windows, focus accounts, pull-forward incentives). Karthik — please prioritize the model that maps win probability to committed revenue so we can quantify downside with scenarios.

Attachments: Q3_coverage_snapshot.xlsx (template), commit_sweep_template.csv
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cQ3_CoverageSnapshot

Thanks — keep asks tight, we need the data to adjust reserved capacity commitments with Finance.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-29T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 launch — coverage action sweep & snapshot

On Wed, Jul 28, 2027 at 9:12 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> As we head into the Q3 launch window I need a quick, executable sweep to close the obvious coverage shortfall in our forecast...

Ack — I'll own the AE roll-up for the West region. Quick status/questions:
- Will we accept "Commit-Contingent" (legal signoff expected within 30 days) as Commit for the purpose of hitting the target? I want to avoid overstating.
- I will push my team's tabs by EOD Fri; can we get a one-hour slot Mon morning for you to walk through the rolled-up heatmap?

Progress note: I've already flagged 3 deals that should move to Commit-Strong pending PO sign (two are Enterprise, one is mid-market). Adding notes to the comment field per your request.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales — West
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: commit_sweep_template.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-30T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 launch — coverage action sweep & snapshot

Vivek / Marissa —

Thanks — I'm on the probability-to-commit mapping. A couple of quick points:
1) "Commit-Contingent" should be modeled separately (we can show two scenarios: conservative where it is excluded, and base where contingent counts at 60% probability).
2) I'll generate the coverage_heatmap.png (attached) broken down by AE and weighted expected vs. committed. That will surface concentration risk (we have 3 AEs with >40% of the "committed" dollars).
3) Suggestion: run a two-week "commit push" incentive (accelerated approval for discounts up to 10%) targeted at top-20 deals; that should convert enough contingent to commit in our model. If leadership approves, CS and Finance need to be looped before execution.

I'll upload the heatmap and the model snapshot to the Drive link after the AE tabs come in.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: coverage_heatmap.png

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 launch — coverage action sweep & snapshot

Perfect — quick operational notes and assigned owners: 
- Marissa: consolidate West AE tabs and upload by EOD Friday (7/30) — owner: Marissa Cole.
- Karthik: deliver heatmap + two-scenario model by Mon 8/2 9am PT — owner: Karthik Iyer.
- Naomi: validate the ACV arithmetic and produce a short memo for Finance on downside exposure (due Tue 8/3) — owner: Naomi Feldman.

Decision on "Commit-Contingent": we will publish both views. For external communications (executive report) we will present the conservative view unless leadership indicates otherwise.

I'll set a 30-minute review Mon 8/2 at 11am PT to finalize mitigation asks and a small discount window proposal. Calendar invite coming.

Thanks — please make comments concise in the spreadsheet (one-line rationale). This is time-boxed and numbers-first.

Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
